finals.race: Download The Star Sports App Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: £190,000 purchase after scoring in points. Built on debut promise to land 2m maiden hurdle at Hereford last December but pulled up (possibly amiss) in 21f novice at Kempton in March on final run for Nicky Henderson. Not written off on yard/chasing debut.

finals.race: OLBG Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Did plenty wrong when placing in a couple of juvenile hurdles at Kempton last winter. Positive signs on the Flat since being gelded, doubling his tally with a fairly useful success at Epsom in late-September. Opening mark looks potentially lenient if he can jump/settle better back hurdling.

finals.race: OLBG Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Better than ever when winning a handicap hurdle at Wincanton prior to finishing mid-field in a strong Class 4 handicap last December. Below his best both starts over fences subsequently, latterly well-held third following a breathing operation. Another who has gone well fresh previously, though.

finals.race: Bet On-Course With Star Sports Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Completed a hat-trick in handicap hurdles at up to 21f last season. Shaped as if better for the run sent chasing after 8 months off when fourth of 7 in handicap at Worcester (2½m, soft) 24 days ago. Can do better now for stable among the winners.

finals.race: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Jet Away gelding. Brother to a winner, and half-brother to 3 winners, including fairly useful hurdler Clever As A Fox. Dam ran once in bumper. In contention when falling 2 out in a point in March. That form looks to have some substance, and yard saddled a couple of recent winning hurdling debutants.

finals.race: Racing At The Heart Of Our Community Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Point winner improved to get within 2¾ lengths of subsequent Silver Trophy winner at Wetherby in March. Let down by his jumping at Punchestown (19f) before likely needing the run (well behind Got A Dream) on softer ground than previously faced on return. Entitled to do better with yard now flying.

finals.race: Star Sports We Believe In Bookmaking EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Picked up for £120,000 after winning second start in Irish points in November 2024. Fourth in a Uttoxeter bumper in March prior to encouraging 6¼-length third on hurdling debut/return at Worcester (2m, soft). Repeat performance should be enough to take this, and she'll be suited by the longer trip.

finals.race: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Maiden who showed enough to think she's got a race in her when runner-up at Wolverhampton in March and got back to that sort of form when creditable second of 6 in minor event at Lingfield (1¼m). Didn't enjoy a smooth passage at Ffos Las but still didn't show enough to seriously consider her.

finals.race: Call Star Sports On 08000 521 321 Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Not straightforward but he put his best foot forward to score over hurdles here (21f) in May. Made mistakes when last of 7 back chasing in handicap at Fontwell (19f, good to soft) 3 weeks ago. Has his stamina to prove here too.

finals.race: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Landed the Swinton at Haydock (2m) in May and better than ever on the Flat since with a pair of 2m handicap wins. Shaping really well on his return to this sphere prior to falling last (still in front) in Silver Trophy at Chepstow (19f, soft) last month. Interesting on first go over 3m.

finals.race: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: Free-going sort who went close to making a winning start for this yard in classified event at Lingfield and backed that up returned to a handicap when third back down in trip there since.

finals.race: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: Has largely held his form this season and return to this longer trip will suit, but has just the one career win from 19 outings.

finals.race: Get Raceday Ready Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
starsports.bet Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fairly useful son of Space Blues. Won 3 of 5 handicap starts (up to 1½m) for the Simon & Ed Crisford stable last season. Best of these on the Flat and in very capable hands for his hurdling debut.

finals.race: starsports.bet Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Regressive on the Flat for Jack Channon. Offered little at long odds in a trio of juvenile hurdles, latterly at Newton Abbot in early-September. Cheekpieces go back on.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Turned in a shocker at York 26 days ago before bouncing back to win a handicap over 11f here 14 days ago, having the run of things from the front. May find this tougher if not enjoying the same tactical advantages back up in grade and trip.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Won twice in 3 starts including at Catterick in September but shaped as if amiss when last of 9 at York in a handicap 27 days ago so now needs to prove well-being back on all-weather.

finals.race: Star Sports Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Much improved for the switch to fences and signed off for last season with a fourth victory in 4-runner handicap at Fontwell (2¾m, good to firm) in April. Has won off a break so not taken lightly on his reappearance.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
finals.comment: C&D winner who hasn't fired this year but is relatively lightly raced of late and now races from below her last winning mark so could do better with cheekpieces back on.

finals.race: attheraces.com/marketmovers 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Kingston Hill gelding. Dam (h99), bumper/2m/17f hurdle winner, also 1m-9f winner who stayed 1¾m on Flat. Wears tongue strap. Yard's newcomers always respected.

finals.race: starsportsbet.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Let down by his jumping over fences in second half of 2025. Held every chance when unseating 3 out at Leicester on latest start in December. Capitalised on a lower hurdles mark following a similar absence last summer and needs a close look from 3 lb lower this time around.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €45,000 2-y-o, Sioux Nation colt. Showed only greenness when last of 9 in a 1m maiden here on debut 44 days ago. Gelded since.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
finals.comment: Hold-up performer who scored at Wolverhampton in January. Below that level since, but probably in need of the run following 4 months off when eighth of 10 in handicap at Kempton (1m) 3 weeks ago. Dangerous to discount from this reduced mark.

finals.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: 750,000 gns purchase who wasn't seen to best effect both starts in handicaps this summer and proved somewhat disappointing in first-time blinkers back in novice company at Kempton (6f) in September. Headgear quickly discarded and needs to show more returned to 7f.

finals.race: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled January 20. 25,000 gns foal, €45,000 yearling, Showcasing colt. Dam 7f-8.6f winner out of useful winner up to 1m (2-y-o 5f-6.5f winner) Penny's Gift. Tongue tied for debut and showed only greenness at Lingfield in September (6f).

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Nursery
finals.comment: Did better with debut under belt when fourth of 13 in novice at Beverley (5f, good to firm) just over 6 weeks ago and now makes the quick switch to a nursery. Upped in trip.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Nursery
finals.comment: Maiden who went backwards from stable debut returned to a nursery when sixth of 12 at this course (5f) 3 weeks ago. Back up in trip.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Nursery
finals.comment: Largely disappointing since encouraging debut sixth in 6f Windsor maiden (winner landed Redcar 2-Y-O Trophy) but a gelding operation and switch to a nursery got him back on track when fourth at Yarmouth on first try over 7f last month. Not so good at Wolverhampton since, however. Cheekpieces on.
